name: proto-blocks/oit-featured-cards
title: OIT Featured Cards
description: Responsive grid of cards. Default: bordered white cards with a small icon, title, description and a corner CTA arrow; one card can be flagged as the red highlight via highlightedIndex. Logo variant: brand-black filled cards with a brand logo at the top and the entire card as the link. Pair with oit-call-to-action above for the intro + CTA.

showBottomCta.label: Show bottom CTA on mobile
showBottomCta.help: Renders an outlined CTA button after the grid, visible only below the desktop breakpoint. Pair with 'Hide button on mobile' on the intro block above.

highlightedIndex.label: Highlighted Card Index
highlightedIndex.help: 1-based index of the card to render with the red highlight variant. 0 = no card highlighted (and every card adopts the red look on hover). Ignored when Logo variant is on.

logoVariant.label: Logo variant
logoVariant.help: Off: bordered white cards with corner CTA arrow (default). On: brand-black filled cards with a logo at the top; the whole card becomes the link.
